subject.title: Feature: Granular Discord action gates (split actions.messages into read/edit/delete)

question: Should Discord retain `actions.messages` as a compatibility shorthand while adding per-operation gates, and which public configuration shape and precedence should govern mixed boolean/granular settings?
rationale: This changes a user-facing least-privilege permission contract; source evidence establishes the gap but cannot determine the intended long-term configuration API or default behavior.

options.title: Add compatible nested gates
options.body: Keep the boolean shorthand as an all-actions compatibility form and add a documented per-operation form with explicit precedence and focused upgrade tests.

options.title: Use separate named Discord gates
options.body: Add individual plugin-owned action flags instead of a nested object, accepting a larger config surface in exchange for simpler validation and docs.

options.title: Keep the coarse gate
options.body: Decline the additional configuration surface and document that disabling message actions intentionally disables all message operations.

recommendation.title: Add compatible nested gates
recommendation.body: Keep the boolean shorthand as an all-actions compatibility form and add a documented per-operation form with explicit precedence and focused upgrade tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and prior review connect this person most directly to the current Discord permission discussion, though ownership evidence is limited.
